review_scope: Frozen first 20 next60 drafts; public originals, public saved metadata and private path-binding metadata only. No private scientific output body or model body was read.
author_independence: Reviewer did not author next60 contracts or native observers. AI-assisted collaboration; independent reading is not independent data origin or a zero-cost claim.

strongest_counter_hypothesis.en: More inventory descriptions and API vocabulary may improve recognition without improving cheap semantic claim prioritization; 96 vectors do not establish 96 independent requests, and two native drafts add no new family.
strongest_counter_hypothesis.ko: 목록 설명과 API 표현이 늘어 이름 인식만 좋아질 수 있습니다. 입력96개는 독립 요청96개가 아니며 native 초안2개도 새 계열을 추가하지 않습니다.

blockers.en: Frozen faithful observer/adapters and executable candidates are missing for these sealed drafts.
blockers.ko: 봉인 초안의 충실한 관측기·adapter·실행 후보가 아직 동결되지 않았습니다.

blockers.en: Minimum source reading lists are not complete new observer package/platform/dependency/toolchain/init closures.
blockers.ko: 최소 원문 목록은 새 관측기의 package·platform·의존성·toolchain·init 전체 범위가 아닙니다.

blockers.en: Coding baseline/correct/mutant verifier evidence and literal compatibility outputs are absent; missing new API alone cannot reject the baseline.
blockers.ko: coding baseline·수정·잘못된 후보의 검증 결과와 literal 호환성 출력이 없으며 새 API 부재만으로 baseline을 거부할 수 없습니다.

blockers.en: All draft release/training-rights fields are false; MPL/cleanhttp and selected copied-origin scopes remain held or unresolved.
blockers.ko: 모든 초안의 release/training 권리 필드가 false이고 MPL/cleanhttp 및 선택 복사 원전 범위가 보류되거나 미해결입니다.

blockers.en: Faithful short candidate inputs, order, limits, connected-family roles, weights and whole retained-resource plan remain separate gates.
blockers.ko: 충실한 짧은 후보 입력·순서·한도·연결 계열 역할·가중치·전체 보존 자원 계획은 별도 조건입니다.

contract_findings.discriminator: vector-01 empty name -> invalid PathError; vector-02 parent path -> invalid before FS
contract_findings.en: Cleaning empty name to dot is a real negative; path.Clean alone does not accept ../a. Freeze all PathError fields and delayed valid-subtree lookup failure.
contract_findings.ko: 빈 이름을 dot으로 정리하면 오류 후보가 되지만 path.Clean만으로 ../a가 유효해지지 않습니다. PathError 전체 필드와 유효 하위 경로의 나중 조회 실패를 고정해야 합니다.

contract_findings.discriminator: vector-04 12,34 rejects grouping instead of stripping all commas
contract_findings.en: Useful grammar contract; define leading zeros, signs, no whitespace and range-error value policy.
contract_findings.ko: 유용한 문법 계약입니다. 선행0·부호·공백 금지·범위 오류 값 정책을 정해야 합니다.

contract_findings.discriminator: vector-01 preserve quoted #/; and trailing comment
contract_findings.en: Pin double-quote and comment options and byte-reader adaptation; string source means filename. Add escaped-backslash and option-off literals.
contract_findings.ko: 따옴표/주석 옵션과 바이트 reader 변환을 고정해야 합니다. 문자열 source는 파일명입니다. 백슬래시 및 옵션OFF literal을 추가해야 합니다.

contract_findings.discriminator: vector-01 negative and vector-02 missing occurrence return range error with whole state unchanged
contract_findings.en: Observe all names, key data, ordering and index arrays; missing index currently returns nil.
contract_findings.ko: 이름·키·순서·인덱스 배열 전체를 관측해야 합니다. 현재 없는 인덱스는 nil을 반환합니다.

contract_findings.discriminator: vector-01 conflicting values and vector-04 equal-valued aliases both reject before assignment
contract_findings.en: Include exact-case plus folded aliases and sorted error names; source reading is not an observed map-order race.
contract_findings.ko: 정확한 case와 변형 키, 정렬된 오류 이름을 포함해야 합니다. 소스 검토는 map 순서 경쟁 관측이 아닙니다.

contract_findings.discriminator: vectors-01/02 mutations never affect the opposite map
contract_findings.en: Legacy getter shares storage; pin nil/empty, registration, error behavior and unchanged shared getter.
contract_findings.ko: 기존 getter는 저장 공간을 공유합니다. nil/빈값·등록·오류·기존 shared getter 보존을 고정해야 합니다.

contract_findings.discriminator: vector-01 nil config error instead of dereference; vector-03 must distinguish an actual wrong implementation
contract_findings.en: Nil/typed-nil Result already errors before metadata/default mutation. A config-only guard does not itself produce typed-nil panic; freeze a concrete early-mutation or wrong-reflection mutant and declared errors.
contract_findings.ko: nil/typed-nil Result는 이미 metadata/default 변경 전에 오류입니다. config guard만으로 typed-nil panic은 생기지 않습니다. 실제 조기 변경/reflection 오류 후보와 선언 오류를 동결해야 합니다.

contract_findings.discriminator: vector-02 two four-byte sources exceed a shared seven-byte budget
contract_findings.en: Use bytes/readers; freeze zero/unlimited, source ownership, reader-error precedence and load budget lifetime.
contract_findings.ko: bytes/reader를 쓰고 0/무제한·source 소유권·reader 오류 우선순위·load 예산 유효기간을 고정해야 합니다.

contract_findings.discriminator: vector-01 empty annotation errors without panic; vectors-02/03 malformed tokens/cardinality reject
contract_findings.en: Add absent/Changed=true/DisableFlagParsing and sorted multiple-error cases.
contract_findings.ko: 없음·Changed=true·DisableFlagParsing·여러 오류 정렬을 추가해야 합니다.

contract_findings.discriminator: vectors-03/04 exact MaxUint64 versus MaxUint64+0.9 range before truncation
contract_findings.en: Useful boundary; integer branch already checked. Pin grammar/negative/resource bounds and integer compatibility.
contract_findings.ko: 유용한 경계이며 정수 경로는 이미 검사합니다. 문법·음수·자원 한도·정수 호환성을 고정해야 합니다.

contract_findings.discriminator: vector-03 exact 16-significant-digit QB result plus input immutability
contract_findings.en: Add ties, suffix carry, >QB and precision18/19; BigBytesN absence alone is not proof.
contract_findings.ko: tie·단위 carry·>QB·정밀도18/19를 추가해야 합니다. BigBytesN 부재만으로 증명되지 않습니다.

contract_findings.discriminator: vectors-01/02 dyadic ties 1.125->1.12 and 1.375->1.38; vector-04 nine decimals
contract_findings.en: Pin float bits/parsing and independent dyadic oracle; add zero-decimal ties, NaN and invalid precision.
contract_findings.ko: float bits/파싱·독립 dyadic oracle을 고정하고 소수0자리 tie·NaN·잘못된 정밀도를 추가해야 합니다.

contract_findings.discriminator: vector-03 lying Stat plus limit+1 still refuses
contract_findings.en: Specify zero, checked limit+1, read/oversize/close errors and partial-data policy.
contract_findings.ko: 0·limit+1 산술·읽기/초과/Close 오류·부분 데이터 정책을 정해야 합니다.

contract_findings.discriminator: vector-01 competitor must appear before destination acquisition in both baseline and corrected routes
contract_findings.en: Trigger-after-Exists alone can disappear in the corrected route. Freeze route-independent fake-FS competition, flags, fs.ErrExist compatibility and joined copy/close errors.
contract_findings.ko: Exists 후 trigger만 쓰면 수정 경로에서 경쟁자가 사라집니다. 독립 fake-FS 경쟁·flags·fs.ErrExist 호환성·copy/close join을 고정해야 합니다.

contract_findings.discriminator: vectors-02/03 short write/cause retention; vector-04 inherited error writer
contract_findings.en: Freeze an unchanged-baseline shim that does not repair discarded errors; new API absence is not a compile-only failure.
contract_findings.ko: 버린 오류를 고쳐주지 않는 baseline shim을 고정해야 하며 새 API 부재를 컴파일 실패로만 세면 안 됩니다.

contract_findings.discriminator: vectors-02/03 run/pre-run error cleanup once; vector-04 sibling isolation
contract_findings.en: Freeze global baseline test scope against no-global-mutation policy; add validation error, repeated executions and global/local order.
contract_findings.ko: 전역 baseline 시험 범위와 전역변경 금지의 관계를 고정하고 검증 오류·반복 실행·전역/로컬 순서를 추가해야 합니다.

contract_findings.discriminator: vector-01 precancel invokes no registered hooks; vector-03 help retained
contract_findings.en: Registered Cobra initializers are not Go package init. Freeze valid context, callback set, help return and option-off literals.
contract_findings.ko: Cobra 등록 initializer는 Go package init이 아닙니다. 유효 context·callback·help 반환·옵션OFF literal을 고정해야 합니다.

contract_findings.discriminator: vectors-01/02 wait >= remaining refuses before timer/next transport
contract_findings.en: Fake clock is not faithful timer instrumentation of unchanged baseline; freeze instrumentation and cause precedence; MPL/cleanhttp rights hold remains.
contract_findings.ko: 가짜 시계만으로 변경 없는 baseline timer를 충실히 계측할 수 없습니다. 계측·cause 우선순위를 정하고 MPL/cleanhttp 보류를 유지합니다.

contract_findings.discriminator: vector-01 masked host bits; vectors-04/05 error keeps previous state
contract_findings.en: Five Wants consistent by source; typed adapter, literal owned IP/mask state and full observer closure missing. Do not synthesize network outputs for IP/IPMask.
contract_findings.ko: Want5개가 원문상 일치하지만 typed adapter·소유 IP/mask 상태·관측기 전체 범위가 필요합니다. IP/IPMask에 network 출력을 만들지 않습니다.

contract_findings.discriminator: vector-01 first nil-error output stops; vector-02 nil-result success; vector-03 ordered newline failures; vector-04 nonnil empty error
contract_findings.en: Four Wants consistent by source; freeze exact hook signatures/reflection values, callback trace and constructor/helper counts separately.
contract_findings.ko: Want4개가 원문상 일치합니다. hook 서명/reflection·callback trace·생성자/helper 횟수를 별도로 고정해야 합니다.

IPNet.invalid_policy: nonnil error; previous IP and mask preserved
IPNet.route_requirement: Freeze exported registration + direct Flag.Value.Set; Changed bookkeeping/error wrapping of FlagSet.Set must not be attributed to direct Value.Set. Constructors/implicit String/helpers separately counted.

OrCompose.route_requirement: Preserve actual OrCompose/Compose semantics with the same hooks; constructor/cached normalization/DecodeHookExec distinct from candidate-vector observations.

alternatives.en: Keep all20 as drafts; expand source contracts only. Smallest change; execution defects remain untested and qualified stays0.
alternatives.ko: 20개 초안을 유지하고 원문 계약만 확대합니다. 변화는 작지만 실행 결함은 미시험이고 적격은0입니다.

alternatives.en: Separately freeze and review native2 observers; Root may run once only under its explicit complete gate/resource plan. Reuses source; still exposed development.
alternatives.ko: native2 관측기를 별도 동결·검토하고 Root의 완전한 조건/자원 계획에서만 한 번 실행합니다. 소스 재사용이 가능하지만 계속 노출된 개발 자료입니다.

alternatives.en: Prepare a small coding subset's faithful baseline/correct/mutant fixtures before30/60. Stronger task-change validation, larger oracle/provenance cost; MPL remains held.
alternatives.ko: 30/60 확대 전에 작은 coding 부분집합의 baseline·수정·잘못된 fixture를 준비합니다. 변경 검증은 강하지만 oracle/원전 비용이 크며 MPL 보류는 유지합니다.

recommended_preparation: B then small C; no executed gates are changed by this review
